description: We’re looking for teammates with: Space/science research interests, UI/UX or web development skills, Creative storytelling and content writing, Data visualization or 3D/interactive design, Presentation and pitching skills
summary:
Echoes of Space: Lost in Orbit is an interactive educational platform developed to explore the stories of NASA's abandoned and forgotten space equipment across the Moon, Mars, and deep space.

Our project transforms forgotten space technology into engaging digital stories, helping students and space enthusiasts understand the history, purpose, and scientific contributions of these machines. It highlights missions such as Apollo, Sojourner, Spirit, and Opportunity, explaining what equipment was left behind, why it was abandoned, and what discoveries it helped accomplish.

The project addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge by making information about discarded space hardware accessible, understandable, and engaging through digital storytelling and AI-powered experiences.

This project is important because these machines are not simply abandoned objects; they represent humanity's achievements in space exploration. By preserving their stories, we inspire future generations to appreciate space science, engineering, and exploration.
details:
Project Details – Echoes of Space: Lost in Orbit

Echoes of Space is an interactive, AI-powered educational web platform that explores NASA's abandoned and forgotten space equipment on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space. It allows users to discover historic space missions, understand the purpose of discarded equipment, and learn about their scientific contributions through engaging storytelling and an AI chatbot that helps answer space-related questions. The project benefits students, educators, and space enthusiasts by making complex space exploration history simple, accessible, and interesting. Its intended impact is to preserve the legacy of space missions, increase scientific awareness, and inspire future explorers and engineers. We developed the platform using Google AI Studio, Gemini AI, and web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Its creativity lies in combining space-history storytelling with AI-powered interaction to turn forgotten space equipment into meaningful learning experiences. During development, we considered accuracy of information, user experience, accessibility, educational value, and the importance of presenting NASA's space exploration history in an engaging way.
